# Material Symbols

The schedule, edit, delete, settings, and close icons (Outlined, 24px) in `src/Icon.tsx` are from Google Material Symbols, licensed under the Apache License 2.0.

- Source: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/blob/master/symbols/web/schedule/materialsymbolsoutlined/schedule_24px.svg
- Other sources follow the same path: `symbols/web/{name}/materialsymbolsoutlined/{name}_24px.svg`.
- License: [material-symbols-LICENSE.txt](material-symbols-LICENSE.txt)

The original path is unchanged. The SVG uses `currentColor` and accessibility attributes for this application.
